description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added support for LWJGL 3.3.3/3.4.1; removed the old LWJGL-Pojav module and aligned native code layout with Amethyst-Android.  
2. Delayed GLFW bridge initialization and added missing 3.4.1 APIs.  
3. Migrated FCLConfig to Kotlin and integrated LWJGL natives paths.  
4. Removed bedrock-style touch control features.  
5. Optimized mod list remote info loading (cache reuse, visible items prioritized).  
6. Fixed NoSuchFileException caused by entry name decoding errors when extracting mixed-encoding zips.  
7. Fixed inability to clear game and Java VM arguments via long-press on the game settings page.  
8. Migrated mod metadata reading from ZipFileTree to zipfs.  
9. Updated Java 25 and netdisk download links.  
10. Updated MioLibPatcher and other runtime components.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.支持 LWJGL 3.3.3 / 3.4.1 双版本，移除旧 LWJGL-Pojav 模块，原生代码向 Amethyst-Android 布局对齐
2.GLFW 桥延迟初始化并补充 3.4.1 缺失 API
3.FCLConfig 迁移 Kotlin 并接入 LWJGL natives 路径
4.删除仿基岩触控相关功能
5.模组列表远程信息加载优化（缓存复用 + 可见条目优先）
6.修复混合编码 zip 解压时条目名解码错误导致的 NoSuchFileException
7.修复游戏设置页面游戏和 Java 虚拟机参数无法通过长按设置为空的问题
8.mod 元数据读取从 ZipFileTree 迁移到 zipfs
9.更新 Java 25 及网盘下载链接
10.更新 MioLibPatcher 等运行时组件
